row.team_price_text: Business: $79/mo billed annually (3 users included, extra users $25 each)
row.evidence: Wistia's help centre says "SSO/SCIM is available on Enterprise and Premium accounts", and the pricing page lists SSO only on the Custom-priced Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Business is a flat $79/mo billed annually with 3 users (extra users $25 each), so no per-user price is recorded; Business + Signals is $329/mo. SSO and SCIM are Enterprise (or legacy Premium). The help centre says SCIM works with Okta only (other IdPs get SAML JIT), while the developer docs call the SCIM 2.0 endpoint generic for any SCIM provider: recorded as a conflict. Okta's OIN app supports SAML, SCIM create/update/deactivate and group push. Deprovisioning deactivates the user and reassigns their My Library content. Account Owners cannot be managed via SCIM. No team-user management API: the Data API only invites 'contacts' by email.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Flat price with 3 users; extra users $25 each.

scim.notes: The Okta guide requires an existing Okta Wistia app configured for SSO; the developer docs do not state an SSO prerequisite.

auth.token_source: Wistia account settings > SSO tab > toggle SCIM provisioning (Account Owner); copy Base URL and API Token

deprovision.data_retained: My Library content is preserved and reassigned to the user set in the SCIM settings (or the oldest Account Owner)

custom.how: Okta Role and Group Role fields set the Wistia role (manager, standard_user, limited_user, viewer)

roles.how: Role attribute per user or Group Role per assigned group; otherwise the default role set in Wistia's SCIM settings

limitations.text: Help centre: SCIM currently supports Okta only; Entra, JumpCloud, OneLogin and PingOne use JIT.
Account Owners cannot be provisioned via SCIM.
Only one SCIM token can be active; generating a new one invalidates the old one.
Pushed Okta groups always create new Wistia contact groups; existing Wistia groups cannot be linked.
Existing users are matched by email only after they are pushed or assigned from Okta.

user_api.notes: The Wistia Data API (https://api.wistia.com/modern) covers media, captions, stats and channels; the only people endpoint is Invite Contacts. No documented endpoints to list, update or remove team users.

endpoints.purpose: Invite one or more people to the account by email (contacts)

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

onelogin.notes: Wistia's guide uses OneLogin's SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); SCIM not supported with OneLogin per the help centre.

jumpcloud.notes: No Wistia page in JumpCloud's support sitemaps; Wistia says JumpCloud is not supported for SCIM.

conflicts.text: The help centre says SCIM supports Okta only and other IdPs use JIT; the developer docs say SCIM is generic and any SCIM 2.0 provider works.
The help centre names the SCIM plans as Enterprise and Premium (legacy); the developer docs say 'higher-tier and Enterprise plans'. The pricing page shows SSO only on Enterprise.

open_questions: Whether SCIM deactivation frees a paid seat or ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether SCIM DELETE hard-deletes users is unclear ('DELETE maps to deprovision').
Supported SCIM user attributes, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
No team-user management or audit-log API found in the Data API reference.
Google Workspace catalogue listing not checked.
